run.heading: Run
run.subheading: Pick a mode. Git output streams into the log; a repo's menu appears below it.
run.empty: Nothing has run yet. Pick a mode above.

option.all: Ask for every repo (ignore mutes and visits)

settings.heading: Settings
settings.subheading: Saved to {path}. Only the folders are required.
settings.pick_folder: Pick a root folder to scan

hint.folders: Each root is walked recursively; the walk stops at the first .git it finds.
hint.commit_command: Run in the repo's own directory when you choose Commit.
hint.file_explorer: [[REPO_PATH]] is replaced with the repo path — quote it yourself.
hint.rename_prefix: Prepended to the folder name by Rename repo; list it under the ignore prefixes too.
hint.ignore_prefixes: Comma-separated. Folders whose name starts with any of these are skipped.
hint.min_modified_age: Commit ask leaves repos touched more recently alone, e.g. 1h, 3d, 2w. Empty: off.
hint.min_visit_age: A settled repo is left alone for this long, e.g. 1h. Empty: the default of 1h.
